description: This file defines a responsive font sizing mixin ('rfs') and related configuration variables for a CSS framework, specifically implementing the RFS (Responsive Font Size) technique outlined in the linked GitHub project. It includes setup for breakpoints, font sizes, and media queries to adapt font sizes dynamically based on screen dimensions.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: A SCSS mixin that calculates and applies a responsive font size, optionally using media queries to scale font sizes based on viewport dimensions.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: A wrapper mixin that includes the 'rfs' mixin for setting font size.

methods.name: responsive-font-size
methods.description: Alias for the 'rfs' mixin, used for setting responsive font sizes.
